comment: Role-pair contrast manifest. min 4.5 rows = WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 AA normal text. min 3.0 rows = large text (SC 1.4.3) or non-text / UI component contrast (SC 1.4.11). Role names are the exact semantic roles defined in tokens/semantic.css. An optional `contexts` array restricts a pair to the contexts where the two roles actually co-occur (a context name matches if it starts with one of the listed prefixes, e.g. "core dark"). Two deviations from the bootstrap plan are documented inline below; see commit message and the Task 9 report.

pairs.name: invert text on invert surface
pairs.note: Deviation from plan: scoped to dark contexts. --surface-invert is the hover/selection background, and --text-invert is light text intended for that raised dark surface (8.7:1 in dark). In light mode --surface-invert is a near-white hover fill (#EFEFEF) and --text-invert is near-white (#F5F5F5); the two roles do not co-occur as fg/bg there, so an unscoped check would assert a pairing the system never renders.

pairs.name: primary button text on primary button bg
default border on surface
pairs.note: Deviation from plan: targets --border-default2 (the visible structural default border) rather than --border-default1, which tokens/semantic.css documents as a deliberately sub-threshold hairline; SC 1.4.11 governs borders required to identify a component, which is --border-default2. Governed in core dark, core light, and themes. The light-mode token was #9D9D9D (2.71:1, under the 3:1 floor); fixed to #8E8E8E (3.28:1) and governed here since.
